claimLimits: aggregate protectedDigest difference identifies its root only, not a leaf
does not run or admit original guard
no filesystem tree traversal or private source reads
does not replace any original fullguard predicate

semantics.differingTopLevelKeys: complete, independently traversed before detailed result construction
semantics.overBound: explicit STOP, complete top keys retained, all delta rows withheld, coverage false and exit 2
semantics.scalarValues: exact parsed values, including integers and strings; no coercion or hash-only substitution
semantics.typeReplacement: one complete node replacement at first type boundary; matching containers recurse
semantics.typedPath: string dict keys and integer list indices, never dotted keys
semantics.unchanged: complete empty delta, not a preservation acceptance

staticSyntax: AST parse and compile only; no module imports or comparison execution
